messages:
olivia: quick heads-up — pushed a tiny WIP CLI: deploy-helper that can 'manifestize' a release and run a dry-run output. objective: fewer manual pin mistakes and standardized change-window metadata.

sam: sweet. what does the CLI look like?

olivia: example: `./deploy-helper manifestize --service web --version 2026-03-12 --change-window \"2026-03-15 02:00-04:00\" --dry-run`

kai: does it auto-generate rollback hints or a pinfile we can consume in the rollout service?

olivia: yes. dry-run prints a pinfile + small manifest and includes a rollback_hint field. sample snippet below:
```
service: web
version: 2026-03-12
pin: true
rollback_hint: "previous: web@2026-03-10"
change_window: 2026-03-15T02:00Z/2026-03-15T04:00Z
```

deploy-bot: checklist: preflight=lint,smoke,metric-check,pin-consistency

maria: are we able to attach a release notes template so PMs can prep notes before apply? would help reduce last-minute rewrites.

olivia: yep — `--notes-template path/to/template.md` will drop a RELEASE_NOTES.md with placeholders and a checklist of required sections (impact, rollback plan, monitor links).

sam: can we support pin strategies? e.g. `--pin-strategy=canary|staged|immediate` with staged defaulting to 10%/30%/100% rollout phases.

olivia: added to the backlog. planning to wire `--pin-strategy` into the rollout controller; default will be staged with configurable phases. also adding `--simulate-traffic` to replay a tiny sample of recent traffic for perf sanity checks.

release-manager: two asks before we flip to apply flow: 1) the helper should auto-create a git tag/PR when `--commit` is passed so release artifacts are traceable; 2) when `--apply` runs it should notify #ops-deploys and require either 2 approvers or an explicit `--force` with admin token.

olivia: good points — implementing `--commit` to create a branch + PR + tag, and `--notify=#ops-deploys`. apply will require a 2-approver handshake by default. `--force` will be admin-only and logged.

maria: small nit — ensure change_window is ISO8601 UTC in manifests so SRE dashboards can parse it without timezone hacks.

olivia: yup, manifest uses ISO8601 UTC now. thanks. I'll push a short README and a couple of example snippets to the repo, and demo in next week's release sync. :party_parrot:

sam: can you also include a tiny unit test for the dry-run output format? happy to review the PR.

olivia: added a test harness and basic coverage in the branch. link (WIP): https://git.internal/redwood/deploy-helper — will ping when PR is ready.

maria: awesome. this should cut down on late-night pin fiddling. :thumbsup:
